scope: Compact PSF 24-channel activity display using the existing audible-frame Live snapshots.

behavior.selection: Click a numbered button to select the same existing PSF Live channel; button blurs for keyboard play. Clicking the already selected CH preserves held audition notes.
behavior.nativeActive: Retain the native Core active flag independently of ENV, including active voices whose ENV is still zero.
behavior.indicator: Light only when native Core active and ENV > 0; underline uses clamp(ENV / 32767, 0, 1). Amber means Gate Off while the indicator is lit, without claiming an exact release stage.
behavior.notOutputLevel: A silent modulator with zero left/right voice volume may remain lit. Gate is the last CPU KON/KOFF request.
behavior.timing: Use the existing at-most-20-Hz, audible-position-aligned PSF snapshot; no new timer, poll, RAM copy, audio client or source-machine write.
behavior.pause: All indicators remain frozen with the same source frame during CH selection and temporary keyboard audition.
behavior.offWaitingErrorStop: Clear unavailable activity rather than show stale values. Off/waiting buttons can still select a channel; source replacement and Stop clear the display.
behavior.layout: Below PSF transport and above Envelope/Waveform/Spectrum. Normally 24 columns; narrow viewport or intermediate-width Files panel uses 12 columns. PSF only; explanations stay behind the existing help control.
behavior.dom: Create 24 stable button/text nodes once; only changed attributes/styles update. Selection uses aria-pressed, independently of native activity.
